accepted_claims: Face states July 1, 2026 and CPI fee increase of 2.29% included.
269277-byte PDF matches retained manual-intake Git bytes at the comparison commit.
qualifications: The uploads/2022 path does not date the operative version.
No numeric fee-table certification here; only the complete first page and date context inspected.

accepted_claims: Memo states building-permit increase 2.29% effective July 1, 2026.
It cites a 2008 BOCC resolution for annual CPI changes to Tables 1-A, 1-B, 1-C and 1-E, without an instrument number.
Separate heading states Transportation Capital Expansion Fee Increase Effective October 1, 2026.
qualifications: October 1, 2026 is later than this review date and is not the building-fee date.
No TCEF amount or percentage appears in this memo; its cost index is separate from the building CPI.
The actual 2008 resolution remains unlocated; identical retained bytes do not establish live currentness.

accepted_claims: Header reads LARIMER COUNTY DEVELOPMENT REVIEW FEE SCHEDULE, EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2026.
Introductory text refers to policy guidelines by separate resolution(s) for equity-based reductions.
86261-byte PDF matches retained manual-intake Git bytes and the recorded historical 752dec44 digest.
qualifications: This schedule is distinct from the 2023 equity resolution and the unretained Attachment A schedule.
Only page 1 was visually checked here; the seven-page rate table is not fully transcribed or certified.

accepted_claims: The title is a revised resolution declaring equity fee reduction for certain community-benefit application types.
Item 1 authorizes the Planning Director to reduce published development fees by 25% for outlined application types.
Item 2 lists conditions/categories; item 3 requires a request at application with a planner.
The execution line visibly reads passed and adopted the handwritten 19th day of December, printed 2023.
Item 4 states through December 31, 2027 at Board discretion, subject to renewal.
qualifications: Item 4 literally prints January 2, 20243; do not silently replace this source anomaly with 2024. The memo supports intended January 2, 2024 implementation, but is not a correction to the signed source.
This resolution authorizes reductions; it does not itself adopt the full fee schedule or the 2008 CPI rule.
Eligibility/discretion and application-time request must accompany any 25% claim; no universal entitlement asserted.
Signature marks and role labels are visible; signer identity, authority and authenticity are not certified.

accepted_claims: Addressed to BOCC from Rebecca Everette, Community Development Director; Date label is Admin Matters, December 19, 2023.
Staff recommend the new Fee Schedule (Attachment A) and revised Equity Fee Resolution (Attachment B).
Page 4 says If adopted and proposed new fee schedules; January 2, 2024 is the proposed implementation date.
The memo discusses phased implementation, recommends CPI timing, and includes proposed special-event fee examples.
qualifications: It is a recommendation memo, not the adopting instrument; reconstructed event SD007-B007 adopting_instrument is too broad.
Attachment A is listed but not included as a full schedule in this four-page memo or separately retained.
Do not convert the proposed special-event examples into adopted or currently payable fees.

accepted_claims: Recorder header reads RECEPTION #20260005307, 2/5/2026 1:21:07 PM, 1 of 2 / 2 of 2, Electronically Recorded.
Printed clerk/recorder label is Tina Harris, Clerk & Recorder, Larimer County, CO.
Page 2 is handwritten January 27, 2026 on the dated line and bears signature marks.

Operative text specifies thirty (30) days, potentially earlier upon the stated code-adoption condition, or further renewal/amendment by separate action; effective as of signature and expiry thirty days thereafter unless continued.
Territorial clause says all of unincorporated Larimer County; hearing noticed for February 9, 2026 at 3:00 pm.
qualifications: Recording date/time is not adoption or signature effectiveness; recorder time zone is not stated.
The thirty-day clause is not the six-month extension draft. No calculated expiry is substituted.
Do not extend county territorial scope into incorporated municipalities; no signer-identity certification.

accepted_claims: Retained HTML states adoption January 27, 2026, a February 9 vote extending to August 25, 2026, and a July 13 further extension to February 25, 2027.
It provides an exact July 13 agenda href: https://larimercoco.portal.civicclerk.com/event/8139/files/attachment/5519.
qualifications: These are official-page narrative assertions; final adopted extension instruments remain unverified.
The original-resolution anchor is literally malformed with a chrome-extension prefix; do not claim that href is a valid public PDF URL.
The July 13 target was not opened in this batch or audit; its contents and document role are not certified.

accepted_claims: Physical pp184-185 staff report recommends extension to August 25, 2026 and supplies a suggested motion.
Attachment A physical pp187-189 is an unsigned/undated proposed resolution with six (6) months and August 25, 2026 expiry language.
The draft differs substantively from the January 27 recorded thirty-day instrument; blank date and Chair/Deputy County Clerk signature lines are visible.
qualifications: Correct the priority description Attachment A reprints establishing resolution: it is an extension-version draft, not an identical reprint.
Past-tense hearing language inside the unsigned draft does not prove passage, publication, or execution.
Only these five physical pages were visually checked; the entire 194-page agenda packet is not certified.

accepted_claims: Handouts HTML states BOCC approved a new development-review fee schedule December 19, 2023, effective January 2, 2024, with annual CPI authorization.
Its actual anchors identify the current schedule, the December 19 memo, and the revised equity resolution.
Related 2025 spotlight has published label June 2, 2025 and effective increase July 1, 2025 (2.27%); 2024 page states July 1, 2024 building increase of 5.22%.
Handouts heading states development-review increase of 2.29% on July 1, 2026.
qualifications: Original SD007-09 groups three HTML resources and lacks its own primary path/hash/size despite the one-resource rule.
This audit binds handouts as one primary source and the two other pages as related support; all original files are unchanged.
Narratives support reported adoption/CPI history but do not replace the absent adopting schedule/resolution.

accepted_claims: Retained building hub links the 2024 building-code amendments and wildfire PDF targets recorded in B013/B014.
qualifications: The two incidental PDFs open structurally (97 and 33 pages) but their substantive contents were not visually reviewed in this audit.
The hub is referral context, not the sought 2008 fee-authorizing resolution; no completeness/currentness claim follows.

findings.title: Counts and bytes reconcile within the recorded delivery
findings.evidence: 23 public events/15 requested URLs; 4 separately logged local PDF reads; 10 unique priority IDs; all 75 unique inventory hashes/sizes and all 23 event body hashes/sizes agree.
findings.required_overlay: Counts are delivery/log counts, not independent certification that every historical browser action is logged.

findings.title: Tar is an incomplete subset of the delivery
findings.evidence: 39 ordinary files and 6 directories; all member bytes match loose files; 36 inventory files omitted.
findings.required_overlay: Use the complete frozen 87-file receipt; do not treat tar alone as a self-contained final package.

findings.title: Not every blocked target was later recovered
findings.evidence: Only 8 of 9 failed Mac URLs have a same-requested-URL browser success. https://www.larimer.gov/sites/default/files/2024-building-permit-fee-schedule.pdf remains 403-only.
findings.required_overlay: Keep that exact URL as blocked-only; do not substitute another schedule URL/version silently.

findings.title: Browser provenance is reconstructed and clocks are unknown
findings.evidence: All 14 browser events have unknown_exact_browser_clock; session summary explicitly says reconstructed from saved artifacts and may still be finalized. Success response headers/full browser transcript are absent.
findings.required_overlay: Verified saved bytes and reported acquisition metadata are distinct; no independent live-fetch or chronology certification.

findings.title: Equity resolution has a printed year anomaly and narrow role
findings.evidence: Direct full-page review and technical crop show January 2, 20243, not literal January 2, 2024. The operative authority is a 25% reduction for specified application types, not adoption of the full fee schedule.
findings.required_overlay: Preserve 20243 verbatim with anomaly note; intended 2024 may only be a separately qualified reading supported by the memo. Retain eligibility, request and discretion conditions.

findings.title: Memo, schedule and adopted equity resolution are separate
findings.evidence: Memo recommends Attachment A schedule and Attachment B resolution; page 4 says If adopted. The delivered separate signed resolution is B, while A is not retained.
findings.required_overlay: Use staff_memo_recommending_adoption for B007; do not treat proposed fee examples or this memo as final adoption of the fee schedule.

findings.title: February packet includes an extension draft, not an identical reprint
findings.evidence: Staff recommend extension; unsigned/undated Attachment A uses six months and August 25 expiry. The recorded January source uses thirty days.
findings.required_overlay: Retain the proposed extension text as draft evidence; obtain executed/adopted extension instrument before promoting its legal effect. Do not infer adoption from past-tense template language.

findings.title: Exact July 13 backlog URL is already preserved
findings.required_overlay: Replace only the Atlas backlog placeholder with that exact discovered-unopened URL. The label describes a hearing agenda/staff report, not necessarily an adopted resolution PDF.

findings.title: SD007-09 bundles multiple resources without a primary digest
findings.evidence: Three related_paths, no local_path/sha256/byte_count; declared priority_rule says one resource each.
findings.required_overlay: Bind handouts HTML as primary and two spotlights as separate related support, with hashes, without expanding the ten-priority cap or editing the submitted record.

findings.title: Moratorium date, territory and signature boundaries
findings.evidence: Recorded Feb5 with dated January27 line; effective on signature; original thirty-day/earlier-event conditions; unincorporated territory. Hub reports later votes.
findings.required_overlay: Keep recording, signature-date statement, noticed hearing and hub-reported vote dates separate. Do not certify current enforceability or signer identity from these copies.

findings.title: Building CPI and future TCEF changes must remain distinct
findings.evidence: 2026 building schedule/memo say July1 and 2.29%; TCEF heading says October1,2026 with no amount. Memo cites but does not identify the 2008 resolution number.
findings.required_overlay: Accept stated dates/roles, not a complete adoption chain; no current TCEF rate inferred.

findings.title: Some retained evidence is earlier context, not new 007 acquisition
findings.evidence: Two meta receipts are dated September10 and describe 403 error bodies; four PDF originals already exist with identical bytes in pinned Git. These are distinct from reconstructed 007 browser events.
findings.required_overlay: Do not count copied prior error metadata as new 007 public attempts or call all bytes newly discovered.

Poppler rendered the smaller sources and packet pp184-185; it stalled on p187 and was interrupted. Remaining packet pages were rendered directly from the same frozen PDF using PyMuPDF and visually inspected.
Source typographic anomalies are preserved; exact Unicode encoding and signature authenticity are not inferred from images.
No complete repeal, amendment, expiry or incorporation chain is established. All candidate intake remains pending.
